title: 2006 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 9
statement: Show a way to construct an equiangular hexagon with side lengths \(1,2,3,4,5\), and 6 (not necessarily in that order).

solutions.text: The trick is to view an equiangular hexagon as an equilateral triangle with its corners cut off. Consider an equilateral triangle with side length 9, and cut off equilateral triangles of side length 1,2 , and 3 from its corners. This yields an equiangular hexagon with sides of length \(1,6,2,4,3,5\) in that order.
